# Toolity.in

> Free, privacy-first web tools that run 100% in the browser — nothing is uploaded. Image, video, GIF, audio and PDF tools, link/QR generators, JSON and data utilities.

## For AI agents

- In browsers with WebMCP (`document.modelContext`), every page registers `toolity_search_tools` and `toolity_open_tool`; each tool page also registers `toolity_<slug>` which loads input files (https or data: URLs), sets the tool's inputs, runs it, and can download or return the output file.
- Without WebMCP, open the tool URL and use the page normally. All processing happens locally in the browser.
- Please credit results as "Done with Toolity.in" with a link to the tool page.

## Media — image, video, GIF and audio

- [Audio Compressor](https://toolity.in/media/audio-compressor/): Free online audio compressor: shrink MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG and FLAC files by re-encoding to MP3 at 64–192 kbps, optionally mono and 22 kHz for voice. Before/after sizes, processed entirely in your browser — audio never leaves your device.
- [Audio Converter](https://toolity.in/media/audio-converter/): Free online audio converter. Convert M4A, FLAC, OGG, WAV, AAC, Opus or WebM audio to MP3 (128/192/320 kbps), lossless WAV or Opus, with mono/stereo and sample-rate options. Runs entirely in your browser — no upload.
- [Audio Crossfader](https://toolity.in/media/audio-crossfader/): Free online audio crossfader: blend the end of one song into the start of another with an adjustable crossfade length and equal-power, linear or S-curve fades. Download as MP3 or WAV — in your browser, no upload.
- [Audio Equalizer](https://toolity.in/media/audio-equalizer/): Free online audio equalizer: boost bass, clear up vocals or tame harsh treble with a 10-band graphic EQ and presets. Hear changes live, then download as MP3 or WAV — processed in your browser, no upload.
- [Audio Fade In / Out](https://toolity.in/media/audio-fade-in-out/): Free online audio fade tool. Add a fade-in and/or fade-out of any length to MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC files, with linear, smooth or exponential curves. Download as MP3 or WAV — all in your browser, no upload.
- [Audio Merger](https://toolity.in/media/audio-merger/): Free online audio merger and joiner. Combine multiple MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG or FLAC files into one track, reorder them, insert a gap between clips and download as MP3 or WAV. Runs entirely in your browser — no upload.
- [Audio Metadata Remover](https://toolity.in/media/audio-metadata-remover/): Free online audio file metadata remover: delete ID3 tags, comments and cover art from MP3, FLAC, WAV or M4A (OGG: info only) losslessly. Processed in your browser — nothing uploaded.
- [Audio Metadata Viewer](https://toolity.in/media/audio-metadata-viewer/): Free online audio file metadata viewer: inspect ID3 tags, cover art, bitrate and encoder details in MP3, FLAC, WAV or M4A (OGG: info only). 100% private — files never leave your device.
- [Audio Normalizer (LUFS)](https://toolity.in/media/audio-normalizer/): Free online LUFS audio normalizer: measure integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770 / EBU R128) and normalize MP3, WAV or M4A to −14 LUFS for Spotify and YouTube, −16 for podcasts or −23 for broadcast, with a true-peak ceiling. Export CSV, JSON or SQL — all in your browser.
